subject: general
question: Two trains P and Q, having lengths of 300 m and 340 m respectively, are running towards each other. If P and Q are running at speeds of 35 m/s and 45 m/s, respectively, then how long will they take to cross each other?
solution:
**Given:**

 The Length of the two trains P and Q are respectively 300 m,340 m .

Speeds of the trains are 35 m/sec,45 m/sec .

**Formula used:**

When two trains are moving in opposite directions, the relative speed will be the sum of their speed.<
